sources.title: Village of Hazelton 2024 SOFI employee schedule
sources.sourceScopeDescription: Complete published employee schedule; this threshold disclosure is not a workforce roster or an annual salary-rate table.
notes: The complete published two-person employee table is retained; employee remuneration and expenses reconcile exactly to all-employee totals minus the numeric under-$75,000 aggregates.
Published name accents are preserved. Remuneration excludes the separately reported expenses. Council and aggregate benefit/reconciliation adjustments are outside this employee cohort.

The report’s broader reconciliation contains a printed $3,318.41 variance and its employee remuneration-plus-expense line differs by $199 from the component totals; these broader lines are not treated as named-employee controls. No source figures are adjusted.

printedControlCells.basis: All-employee remuneration and expense totals minus the numeric under-threshold aggregates.

sources.publicWarning: Named employee remuneration and expenses reconcile exactly. The report separately prints a $3,318.41 broader accounting reconciliation variance; its employee remuneration-plus-expenses reconciliation line is $199 above the printed component totals. Those broader lines are not used to change the published individual amounts.

sources.title: Village of Port Clements 2025 SOFI employee schedule
sources.sourceScopeDescription: Complete published employee schedule; this threshold disclosure is not a workforce roster or an annual salary-rate table.
notes: The complete published one-person employee table is retained; name is published and no employee position column is published, so position remains missing.
The source explicitly says remuneration includes taxable benefits. Expenses and the expense-inclusive Total are separate; Total is supporting evidence and is not used as pay.
Named remuneration and expenses reconcile exactly to all-employee totals minus numeric under-$75,000 aggregates. Council and under-threshold aggregates are excluded; no compiled records are removed.

printedControlCells.basis: All-employee totals minus numeric under-threshold aggregates; expense-inclusive row Total is supporting evidence only.
